A '''golden shovel''' is a [[Tools#Shovel|shovel]] of the [[Golden equipment|golden]] tier, crafted from a [[gold ingot]] and two sticks. At speed {{Value|Golden Shovel|miningspeed}} it ties the [[adamant shovel]], and only the [[hepatizon shovel]] (20) digs faster.

== Usage ==

=== Digging ===
It breaks shovel blocks at speed {{Value|Golden Shovel|miningspeed}} and has {{Value|Golden Shovel|durability}} durability. It has Fortune I, and it collects snowballs from snow. Golden gear comes with its enchantments already applied. They are ordinary enchantments, so they can be combined or removed like any other.

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Golden Shovel|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Golden Shovel|attackspeed}}.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[gold ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one gold ingot.
